responsibility: Implements the core middle-end rules for which tree types and expressions are valid in GIMPLE and how they should be treated. It owns substantive predicates and helpers behind gimple-expr.h, including useless type-conversion tests, invariance and register/lvalue classification, address and call operand validity, and addressability marking/deferral during RTL expansion, thereby defining much of the stable contract between generic tree expressions and the restricted forms accepted by GIMPLE and SSA-based passes.
same_name_distinction: Contains the substantive implementations behind gcc/gimple-expr.h for GIMPLE expression/type legality and addressability, such as useless_type_conversion_p, register/value/lvalue classification, call and MEM_REF operand validation, and deferred mark_addressable handling; the header mainly exposes these APIs and small inline classifiers.
